question: Across all 30 sealed V9 cases, when a current-node frontier target is followed by a graph event, how often does the robot depart through the selected stub, depart through a different verified stub, or return to the same node after persistent target action?
method: Verify the finalized 90-case source plus all 30 V9 traces and snapshots. Reconstruct contiguous target identity and route-arc persistence, compare each inter-node event with the exact exit stub consumed by the graph's own verified traversal rule, and preserve same-node loop merges separately. Aggregate against only the already frozen per-case waypoint lookahead and graph-event travel scales.
baseline: This is a no-GT mechanism audit of the V9 method, not a performance comparison or parameter-selection run. Original M-TARE remains the primary performance baseline in the separate frozen compatibility analysis.

user_authorization.scope: One immutable read-only Gate-6 mechanism audit after the exact 90-case source is finalized and sealed.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: Standing user authorization for autonomous in-scope execution; this proposal cannot execute before final source binding.

acceptance_criteria: The sealed source has exactly 90 V2-PASS cases and exactly 30 V9 cases.
All 30 V9 decision traces and 30 snapshots match the source seal and have contiguous frames, monotone route arc and valid graph identities.
Every classified event preserves its target-run frame and route-arc persistence and uses only the source graph's exact departure-stub rule.
Aggregate persistence counts use only each case's already frozen waypoint-lookahead and minimum-event-travel values; no new selected threshold is introduced.
Source mutation, raw bag read, training, model selection and C09/C10 reads are zero.
stop_conditions: Any source state, status, count, schedule, seal, file or case-contract drift.
Any invalid target identity, node, stub, frame order, route arc, planner configuration or trace/snapshot hash.
Any source mutation, bag read, training, threshold selection or C09/C10 read.
expected_evidence: Thirty V9 frontier-attempt outcome records and aggregate persistence statistics.

estimated_cost.compute: Read-only CPU JSON audit; no simulation, ROS, GPU or raw bag decompression.
